moments.author: Todd Monken
moments.quote: Deshaun Watson named starting QB due to full body of work through preseason
moments.why: Watson gets the Week 1 nod despite preseason boos, spotlighting the Browns’ controversial choice and igniting fan backlash.

moments.author: Deshaun Watson
moments.quote: I thought I was going to get a little different response… my emotions got the best of me
moments.why: His apology after calling fan boos “personal” went viral, fueling debate over sincerity—and whether emotion or PR sparked it.

moments.author: Ryan Fitzpatrick
moments.quote: "Once he fails, Shedeur is gonna jump in… the city is gonna be behind him."
moments.why: Fitzpatrick’s live comment nails the fan sentiment shift—Cleveland’s patience is gone and they’re ready for Sanders.

moments.author: profootballnetwork.com
moments.quote: NFL fans rip Watson’s apology: “Nobody believes this garbage!”
moments.why: Captured the savage social reaction to Watson’s apology—skepticism and anger dominated the trending responses.

moments.author: The Spun (via Adam Schefter quote)
moments.quote: Just in: Deshaun Watson has been named Cleveland’s starting quarterback for week 1 at Jacksonville.
moments.why: The initial insider drop that kicked off the viral frenzy—trending heavily among fans and sports media.
